description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developments - Amendment to the Gaz. Extra Ordinary No. 2129/95 of the 28.06.2019, published on Polonnaruwa Urban Development Areas
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the rectification of a previous legal notice regarding urban development plans and amendments to the Urban Development Authority Law. It deals with statutory instruments, legal amendments, and regulatory compliance under specific legislation (Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978), making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
